traits.name: Commander's Tactics
traits.description: Unlocks short-cooldown tactical battle cries and single-stance Warcry sharing starting at Lv. 10.

traits.name: Berserker's Fury
traits.description: Amplifies Attack, Double Attack, Weapon Skill Damage, and the ferocity of Warrior's offensive abilities.

traits.name: Spartan's Phalanx
traits.description: Grants Polearm and Size-1 Buckler Mastery, Spartan's Grit damage-to-barrier conversion, charge-based Melee and Spell Brace deflection, and phalanx mitigation.

traits.name: Sensei's Flow
traits.description: Mastery of Staff deflection: parrying and evading incoming blows restore HP and TP, build enmity, and trigger automatic ripostes.

traits.name: Stillwater's Pulse
traits.description: Empty-handed ranged Light Chi bolts (up to 20y) emit a 12y AoE healing pulse around your target while mending you from range.

traits.name: Wayfarer's Mastery
traits.description: Pure Hand-to-Hand oath: amplifies Kick Attacks, Double Attack, Critical Hits, and Weapon Skill Damage, and refunds bonus TP after every landed H2H weapon skill.

traits.name: Solace Conduit
traits.description: Unlocks proactive Afflatus Solace at Lv. 10 so single-target Cures apply Solace Ward barriers and mitigation, and empowers Banish, Holy, and weapon skills to recover MP and build Sacred Grace stacks for party Regen.

traits.name: Harbinger's Drain
traits.description: Eligible Scythe weapon skills restore a dependable share of Max HP to Tank Thralls (Undead Warrior / Dullahan) and heal Caster Thralls (Undead Mage / Corse) based on weapon-skill damage dealt.

traits.name: Dark Pact
traits.description: While an Undead thrall is active, grants scaling Double Attack, Store TP, and Accuracy.

traits.name: Grim Conversion
traits.description: Converts Magic Accuracy into Accuracy, Magic Attack Bonus into Attack, Fast Cast into Haste, and Magic Burst Bonus into Weapon Skill Damage.

traits.name: Crimson Riposte
traits.description: Parrying with a 1H Sword and empty off-hand triggers light/ice counter-damage, heavy volatile enmity, and MP recovery.

traits.name: Perpetual Majesty
traits.description: Always active at Lv. 10+ with no lockout: single-target Cures splash at full potency to party members within 15y, and overhealing grants Light's Grace regeneration for 10s.

traits.name: Aegis Devotion
traits.description: Grants Club & Shield Mastery (scaling Club/Shield skill, Block Rate, Shield Mastery TP, and full spell interruption immunity) and unlocks Divine Intercept while wielding Club + Shield above 35% HP.

traits.name: Dreadnought's Carapace
traits.description: Grants growing Scythe and Dark Magic skill, Parry rate, faster Dark Magic casting, and full Spell Interruption immunity on Dark Magic, while empowering Drain II Blood-Pool, instant Absorb Blood Tithe weaving, and Tithe-scaled Dread Spikes barriers.

traits.name: Alpha's Soul-Link
traits.description: Enables zero-jug Guardian Beasts (Crab, Beetle, Tortoise, Tiger), always-on Soul-Link damage sharing, master enmity funneling, Guardian AoE/conal immunity, Cure and overheal mirroring, and pet-healing 1H Axe weapon skills when wielding a 1H Axe with an empty Sub slot.

traits.name: Dual Wield
traits.description: Unlocks wielding a weapon in each hand and reduces dual-wield attack delay as you level.

traits.name: Skald's Tempo
traits.description: Grants Dual Wield and growing DEX, CHR, Attack, Accuracy, and Critical Hit rate; enables Dagger/Sword Cadence stacking, song-scaled Sonic weapon-skill follow-ups, and Encore haste.

traits.name: Cantor's Resonance
traits.description: Converts Threnodies, Requiems, Elegies, and Magic Finale into CHR- and MAB-scaled magical nukes capable of Magic Bursting, builds Cantor's Resonance, protects party buff songs from being overwritten, and scales your casting stats and Refresh with level.

traits.name: Provocateur's Bulwark
traits.description: Grants heavy Volatile and Cumulative Enmity on offensive and debuff songs, passively empowers active Minne, Paeon, and Scherzo auras, and strengthens tank survivability and spell interruption resistance as you level.

traits.name: Warden's Ration
traits.description: Eligible Archery and Marksmanship weapon skills heal your active beast for a level-scaled share of its Max HP and grant it a strong burst of Pet TP.

traits.name: Primeval Pack
traits.description: Provides starter Crossbow and bolts at Lv. 10 if empty, full Ammo Recycle, no ranged distance damage penalty, and growing Max HP, Archery/Marksmanship skill, Ranged Accuracy, Snapshot/Rapid Shot, and Store TP while a pet is active.

traits.name: Apex Bond
traits.description: Defines your modal pet stance: Glacial Tusker (Wild Raaz / Cehuetzi) anchors bosses with heavy pet durability, AoE/conal immunity, threat forwarding, and Cure forwarding; Volcanic Saurian (Stalker Raptor / Gabbrath) projects a 15y Party Pack Aura.

traits.name: Ronin's Mushin
traits.description: Requires a Great Katana: unlocks multi-charge Mind's Eye counter-anticipation, Mushin Stagger damage deferral, and enhanced Seigan tank mitigation.

traits.name: Oisoya Mastery
traits.description: Elevates Archery to A+ while preserving arrows without consuming them, enables 20y Bow auto-attacks with no point-blank penalty, and powers the Drawn Oisoya and Cosmic Brand combo loop.

traits.name: Onimaru's Command
traits.description: Requires a Great Katana: empowers 20s Hagakure Iaijutsu Sundering draw-slashes, party-wide Ashura's Edge auras, and Onimaru Blood-Quench Skillchain recovery surges.

traits.name: Kagemusha Phantom
traits.description: Requires Dual Katanas: grants faster, uninterruptible zero-tool Ninjutsu, clean Utsusemi overwrites, Shadow Smoke and Kawarimi Ash generation on broken shadows, and Katana weapon-skill shadow and HP recovery.

traits.name: Wyrmblood Breath
traits.description: Requires a Polearm and active Wyvern: unlocks in-combat Call Wyvern and core triage Jumps from Lv. 10+, commands Wyvern Crimson Triage with overheal Stoneskin on Polearm weapon skills, and powers the Wyrmscale Restoring Breath loop.

traits.name: Astral Sanctuary
traits.description: Projects the 15y Celestial Sanctuary Regen, Refresh, and mitigation aura from your active Avatar, eliminates Avatar perpetuation cost, shortens Blood Pact: Ward recasts, and triggers Starlight Mend party and Avatar heals on Wards and Staff/Club weapon skills.

traits.name: Dual Wield
traits.description: Unlocks wielding a weapon in each hand and reduces dual-wield attack delay.

traits.name: Azure Diffusion
traits.description: Healing Blue Magic splashes across nearby party members within 15y, while dual-wield hits build Azure Catalyst (max 5) to unleash Azure Mending Wave party HP and MP recovery at 5 stacks or on Sword/Club weapon skills.

traits.name: Dual Wield
traits.description: Unlocks wielding a weapon in each hand and reduces dual-wield attack delay.

traits.name: Azure Carapace
traits.description: Grants early Dual Wield, uninterruptible casting, and Chitin Carapace stacking (max 5, 15s) from designated physical Blue Magic—empowering defensive Blue Magic with extra potency and MP return at 3+ stacks.

traits.name: Flintlock Deadeye
traits.description: Replaces party Phantom Roll with the self-only Deadeye Chamber buff (15s recast, 30s duration) and empowers Quick Draw (2 charges, 10s recharge) to apply a 10s Powder Mark that Marksmanship weapon skills detonate for bonus fire damage and TP.

traits.name: High Roller Stakes
traits.description: Non-bust rolls (1–10) maintain a high Safe Standing baseline, while Lucky and XI hits trigger Overdrive potency, clear Bust, and pulse TP and MP to party members within 15y.

traits.name: Blackwake Bulwark
traits.description: Replaces party rolls with the defensive self-only Galleon's Roll (20s recast, 60s duration) and turns one-handed Sword weapon skills into Point-Blank Pistol enmity blasts with self-healing and Grapeshot stacking (max 3) for Quick Draw Salt-Spray barriers.

traits.name: Ironlink's Core
traits.description: Configures your automaton as a single-target Valoredge tank with full Overload Immunity, enhanced Strobe/Shield Bash/Cannibal Blade, and a Hand-to-Hand weapon-skill loop that heals Valoredge, shields you with Alloy Plating, and inflicts Cripple.

traits.name: Clockwork Medic
traits.description: Equips your automaton with built-in White Magic (Cure I–V, Erase, and status removal), full Overload Immunity, and Light/Water/Earth Maneuver directives backed by Hand-to-Hand Aether Cell generation.

traits.name: Tandem's Rhythm
traits.description: Master Hand-to-Hand weapon skills inject bonus TP into your automaton and apply an 8s single-target Tandem Opening mark that boosts your automaton's qualifying weapon skill and extends the Skillchain window by 3s.

traits.name: Crimson Waltz
traits.description: Turns Drain Samba into a scaling 15y party lifesteal aura whose overhealing forms Crimson Veil Stoneskin barriers, while Steps grant 2 Finishing Moves and party healing and Dagger/Throwing weapon skills detonate up to 5 Finishing Moves for AoE healing and cleansing.

traits.name: Mirage Rhythm
traits.description: Dual Dagger Mastery enhances Dual Wield speed, Parry Rate, Subtle Blow, and Dagger/Parrying skills while enabling Fan Dance Rhythm—a Waltz-friendly defensive stance whose decaying mitigation is recharged by Dagger weapon skills.

traits.name: Dual Wield
traits.description: Unlocks wielding a weapon in each hand and reduces dual-wield attack delay.

traits.name: Chirurgeon's Grace
traits.description: Unlocks Call Eos, extends Addendum: White to 2 hours, accelerates Sublimation charging without HP drain, and grants free 10y AoE coverage on qualifying Cure and Regen spells.

traits.name: Heliarch's Wisdom
traits.description: Unlocks Call Titania, extends Addendum: Black to 2 hours, maintains permanent Ebullience for black magic, and empowers Helix spells with extended 2-hour duration.

traits.name: Sylvan Bloom
traits.description: Living Luopan Sanctuary pulses Verdant Bloom every 3s (15y) to heal allies, restore MP, and convert overhealing into Barkskin barriers; Sylvan Resonance restores Luopan HP and triggers Nature's Surge (party heal and 1-debuff cleanse) on qualifying spells and Club/Staff weapon skills.

traits.name: Runic Brand
traits.description: Enhances Rune mastery, triggers elemental discharges on Great Sword swings and weapon skills, and rewards Rune resonance.

traits.name: Sacred Pulse
traits.description: Unlocks 3-Rune Mastery at Lv. 10+, transforms Vivacious Pulse into a 15s Party AoE heal with Rune-driven boons, enables Runic Lifetap on melee attacks, and projects Regen spells to nearby allies.

traits.name: Runeweft's Ward
traits.description: Unlocks 3-Rune Mastery at Lv. 10+, preserves Runes on Swipe, Lunge, Gambit, and Rayke, triggers Runic Riposte on Parry, and enables dual defensive Tank Stances.
